confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Venice pricing for a July high-season window; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant anchors (meals, coffee, beer) are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely with season and location. Cocktail and wine were set from the local price relationship to beer and the typical spritz price, because direct knowledge is weak. The FX observation came from search-result text summarising the rba.gov.au exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against central Florence and Rome as Italian cities with comparable tourist-season restaurant and hotel pricing, adjusted upward for Venice's premium July demand and limited supply of rooms.
